tests.title: Jog movement, touch and direction
tests.why: Test actual hardware response without inventing MIDI IDs, audio tolerances or HID mappings.
steps: Check DJControl Inpulse T7 official manual, ports and operating mode.
Exercise all jog controls or signal routes using MIDI monitor, DJ software or external measurement as appropriate.
Repeat, save evidence and distinguish unobservable from failed hardware.
equipment: Compatible host or measurement interface as needed
